claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: OMDM-2 is a lipophilic N-oleoylethanolamine analogue that at 2.5 uM most plausibly causes non-selective membrane/lysosomal stress typical of cationic amphiphilic or lipophilic compounds, rather than FAAH- or GPR119-mediated cytotoxicity.
